# defectdojo_jira_instance (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a DefectDojo Jira instance by ID or name, for example to connect a `defectdojo_jira_project` to an instance managed elsewhere. It needs a superuser, or the configuration permissions for Jira instances.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_jira_instance" "acme" {
  configuration_name = "Acme Jira"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `configuration_name` (String) The name of the Jira instance to look up, compared exactly. Exactly one of `id` and `configuration_name` must be set. DefectDojo doesn't require unique names: the lookup fails when several instances have the name.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the Jira instance to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `configuration_name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `accepted_mapping_resolution` (String) The Jira resolutions that make a finding risk accepted, if set.
- `close_status_key` (Number) The ID of the Jira transition that closes issues.
- `critical_mapping_severity` (String) The Jira priority of critical findings' issues.
- `default_issue_type` (String) The type of new Jira issues.
- `epic_name_id` (Number) The number of Jira's Epic Name custom field.
- `false_positive_mapping_resolution` (String) The Jira resolutions that make a finding a false positive, if set.
- `finding_jira_sync` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo pushes changes of findings to their issues.
- `finding_text` (String) Text added to the issues of findings, if set.
- `global_jira_sla_notification` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo posts SLA notifications as comments on issues.
- `high_mapping_severity` (String) The Jira priority of high findings' issues.
- `info_mapping_severity` (String) The Jira priority of info findings' issues.
- `issue_template_dir` (String) The folder of the templates that render issue descriptions, if set.
- `low_mapping_severity` (String) The Jira priority of low findings' issues.
- `medium_mapping_severity` (String) The Jira priority of medium findings' issues.
- `open_status_key` (Number) The ID of the Jira transition that reopens issues.
- `url` (String) The URL of the Jira server.
- `username` (String) The user name or email address of the Jira account.
